name: Social Auth Yandex
description: Adds Login with Yandex (OAuth) to Social Auth.
project_description:
Social Auth YAndex allows users to register and login to your Drupal site with their Yandex account. The module allows websites to request any scopes, so any tasks requiring authentication with Yandex services can be performed. This module is based on Social Auth and Social API projects.

 This module adds a path user/login/yandex which redirects the user to Yandex Accounts for authentication.

 Login process can be initiated from the "Yandex" button in the Social Auth block. Alternatively, site builders can place (and theme) a link to user/login/yandex wherever on the site.
